title: CLI party UX
description: Player-facing affordances for a party. ensureCharacterReady checks only the single active PC and there is no way to add PCs, list the party, or switch the active PC. Add: creation of additional PCs (reuse completeCharacterCreation with explicit characterId pc-2..N), /party (list roster), /switch <pc> (set meta.active_character_id), and relax ensureCharacterReady to require at least one canonical PC. Depends on party roster read API. Acceptance: can create a second PC, list the party, switch active PC across turns; ensureCharacterReady passes with >=1 complete PC; CLI tests for each command.
close_reason: Added /party, /switch, /addpc session commands (playParty.ts + turn-loop wiring) and createAdditionalCharacter; relaxed readiness to any canonical PC. 5 CLI tests. Full suite green (764 passed). Committed.
